prisoners_dilemma.ess_reference: Defect strictly dominates -> all-Defect x*=(0,1) is the unique ESS.
prisoners_dilemma.prediction: Cooperator share -> 0; the population collapses to all-Defect.

hawk_dove.ess_reference: Interior mixed ESS at p(Hawk)=V/C=0.500 (V=2.0, C=4.0).
hawk_dove.prediction: Converges to the interior ESS x*=(0.500,0.500) from any interior start.

rock_paper_scissors.ess_reference: Unique Nash = uniform (1/3,1/3,1/3); NO ESS (interior fixed point is a centre, not an attractor).
rock_paper_scissors.prediction: Orbits around (1/3,1/3,1/3) forever; the last iterate NEVER converges (closed orbits under continuous replicator dynamics).

stag_hunt.ess_reference: Two pure ESS (Stag,Stag) payoff-dominant and (Hare,Hare) risk-dominant; an unstable interior fixed point separates their basins.
stag_hunt.prediction: Converges to all-Stag OR all-Hare depending on x0 (which basin the start lands in).
